d:
Presenting Dukaalan Pranaase, a heartfelt Gurbani rendition by Daler Mehndi.
Dukaalan Pranaase is a timeless prayer that inspires courage, resilience, faith, and unwavering devotion. It has guided generations through difficult times, reminding us to place our trust in the Divine.
This rendition is my humble offering at the feet of Guru Sahib. I pray it brings peace to your mind, strength to your spirit, and blessings to your home.
Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa
Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh.
Credits
Singer & Composer: Daler Mehndi
Sacred Composition: Sri Jaap Sahib by Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji Maharaj
